title: Solids concentration by treatment process

cell_spans.description: Printed 'Solids concentration (%)' spans the Excess sludge and Mixed sludge columns
Printed 'Treatment process' spans both header rows

markdown:
| Treatment process | Excess sludge | Mixed sludge |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Conventional activated sludge process | 0.5-1.0 | 1.0 |
| Oxidation ditch process | 0.5-1.0 | - |
| Extended aeration process | 0.5-1.0 | - |
| Sequencing batch reactor process (low load) | 0.5-1.0 | - |
| Biological aerobic filtration process | - | 1.0 |
| Contact oxidation process | 0.8 | 1.0 |
notes: Printed below the table: 'Source: Guideline and Manual for Planning and Design in Japan, JSWA, 2009', with JSWA in italics.
Transcriber layout note: two printed header rows. Row 1 reads 'Treatment process' and 'Solids concentration (%)' (spanning two columns); row 2 reads 'Excess sludge' and 'Mixed sludge'.
The Mixed sludge column prints '-' for three processes; retained as printed.
Printed as 'Sequencing batch reactor process (low load)' with a lower-case 'low load'; retained.
Printed caption ends with a trailing space after 'process'; not reproduced in the title.

transcription.method: Direct viewing of the annotation-cleaned 144 dpi page renders and 260-800 dpi crops of the same pages; no OCR, no paid service
transcription.observations: Header levels and all six data rows read from a 300 dpi crop; the six concentration values and the four hyphens checked individually.
